evals.name: High-Resolution Web Map Quickstart
evals.prompt: Create a full-screen interactive map in Leaflet with crisp high-resolution tiles, zoom navigation controls, and proper attributions.
evals.expected_output: A complete HTML page importing Leaflet 1.9.4 CSS and JS, with an explicit 100vh map container, initializing L.map with center in [lat, lng] format, adding L.tileLayer with tileSize: 512, zoomOffset: -1 (using MapTiler high-DPI tiles), and required copyright attributions.

evals.name: Interactive Demographic Choropleth Map
evals.prompt: Build an interactive demographic choropleth map in Leaflet with color brackets, a legend box, and hover highlight tooltips.
evals.expected_output: A complete HTML file loading a polygon GeoJSON dataset, a getColor helper function mapping density values to color hex codes, L.geoJSON with style and onEachFeature mouseover/mouseout listeners, and an L.control legend.

evals.name: Marker Clustering with Popups
evals.prompt: Create a Leaflet map clustering 1,000 store locations with animated cluster bubbles and popup details on marker click.
evals.expected_output: A standalone page loading Leaflet 1.9.4 and leaflet.markercluster, initializing L.markerClusterGroup(), adding markers with L.marker and bindPopup, and adding the cluster group to the map.

evals.name: Animated Route Polyline
evals.prompt: Create an animated marching delivery route line on a Leaflet map showing motion direction along coordinates.
evals.expected_output: A web page loading Leaflet and leaflet-ant-path plugin, instantiating L.polyline.antPath with GPS coordinates, configuring pulseColor, delay, dashArray, and adding to the map.

evals.name: Split-Screen Satellite Swipe Comparison
evals.prompt: Create an interactive split-screen swipe comparison slider in Leaflet between satellite imagery and a street map.
evals.expected_output: A web page with two L.tileLayer instances (streets and satellite), loading leaflet-side-by-side plugin, calling L.control.sideBySide(leftLayer, rightLayer).addTo(map).
